name: Critical Service Dependency Models
mechanism: Model cascading loss across water, energy, food, communications and care rather than treating each outage independently
operating_requirement: Maintained service topology, measured capacities and operators able to inspect assumptions
consequence: Identify common dependencies before investing in nominally separate backups

name: Independent Service Reserve Design
mechanism: Separate backup services from shared fuel, flood, cable and staffing failure domains
operating_requirement: Real reserve equipment, independent connections, fuel and trained relief staff
consequence: Reduce correlated service failure at continuing maintenance cost

name: Cross Service Restoration Sequence
mechanism: Order restoration so dependent pumps, controls and clinics receive usable upstream services
operating_requirement: Damage assessment, working crews, access, repair materials and a feasible starting source
consequence: Restore coupled infrastructure through paid staged work

name: Refuge Capacity Qualification
mechanism: Rate refuge occupancy against the limiting sustained water, food, sanitation, care and ventilation service
operating_requirement: Inspected shelter, actual stocks, accessible routes and service staff
consequence: Admit and support bounded displaced populations without creating supplies

name: Relocation Reception Networks
mechanism: Match evacuation departures to confirmed reception capacity and reachable transport
operating_requirement: Consent and coordination, functioning routes, carriers, fuel and receiving households or shelters
consequence: Move actual people without duplicating residents or exhausting destination services

name: Distributed Emergency Fabrication
mechanism: Allocate urgent replacement parts among qualified surviving workshops and inspect substitutes
operating_requirement: Compatible drawings, available feedstocks, tooling, power, transport and inspectors
consequence: Recover selected services through distributed paid manufacturing

name: Cross Region Recovery Compacts
mechanism: Prearrange restoration responsibilities and reciprocal resource claims across affected regions
operating_requirement: Participating authorities, verified spare capacity, enforceable commitments and transport
consequence: Obtain external recovery help with repayment and competing demand

name: Multi Hazard Refuge Siting
mechanism: Compare refuge sites against overlapping flood, heat, fire and route failure scenarios
operating_requirement: Surveyed land, local hazard evidence and infrastructure cost estimates
consequence: Reduce displacement into a different exposure while retaining access

name: Prosthetic Intent Decoding
mechanism: Infer intended movement from repeatable user signals and calibrated patterns
operating_requirement: Fitted sensors, powered prosthesis, individualized training and clinical support
consequence: Offer bounded voluntary control of compatible prostheses

name: Prosthetic Sensory Feedback
mechanism: Return measured contact or joint-state cues through a trained sensory channel
operating_requirement: Qualified sensors and feedback interface, power, fitting and supervised practice
consequence: Improve selected manipulation tasks with feedback rather than restored natural sensation

name: Neural Interface Rehabilitation
mechanism: Couple measured neural activity to supervised feedback for a specified rehabilitation task
operating_requirement: Qualified interface, clinicians, consent, signal processing and repeated assessment
consequence: Investigate or deliver only indication-specific validated rehabilitation

name: Assistive Device Continuity
mechanism: Maintain fit, compatible replacement modules and individualized settings across device changes
operating_requirement: Service records, available components, technicians and recurrent user assessment
consequence: Reduce loss of daily function during repairs and changing needs

name: Longitudinal Health Record Linkage
mechanism: Link a consenting person's observations across time while preserving identity and measurement context
operating_requirement: Accessible records, reliable identity matching, provenance and clinical stewardship
consequence: Support life-course assessment without assuming that correlation proves benefit

name: Aging Intervention Endpoint Design
mechanism: Distinguish changes in surrogate markers from demonstrated function, morbidity or survival outcomes
operating_requirement: Defined cohorts, validated measurements, follow-up capacity and statistical review
consequence: Evaluate candidate interventions without awarding lifespan from a biomarker alone

name: Aging Intervention Programs
mechanism: Compare proposed aging interventions against prespecified benefit and harm endpoints over time
operating_requirement: Qualified investigational products, consent, care, sustained follow-up and independent review
consequence: Produce bounded positive or negative evidence; deployment follows demonstrated benefit

name: Organ Replacement Matching Networks
mechanism: Coordinate compatible organ allocation with recipient readiness and time-sensitive transport
operating_requirement: Consenting sources, qualified matching evidence, surgical capacity and maintained transport conditions
consequence: Use available organs with accountable allocation and fewer avoidable logistical losses

name: Remote Care Task Delegation
mechanism: Assign defined care tasks to locally competent teams when a distant specialist cannot act directly
operating_requirement: Local caregivers, scope-specific training, supplies and escalation arrangements
consequence: Extend supported care while retaining local competence requirements

name: Care Continuity During Displacement
mechanism: Transfer active treatment obligations with displaced people and verify actual receiving capacity
operating_requirement: Accessible essential records, medicines, receiving clinicians and delivery routes
consequence: Reduce interruption of continuing treatment during relocation

name: Adaptive Access Interfaces
mechanism: Adapt input and presentation methods to evaluated sensory or motor access needs
operating_requirement: Compatible devices, user trials, support and maintained alternative channels
consequence: Allow more people to use the same learning and civic services

name: Trace Element Cycle Recovery
mechanism: Recover selected scarce trace constituents from mixed waste streams with measured purity
operating_requirement: Characterized streams, selective separation plant, reagents, energy and residue disposal
consequence: Reduce specified make-up inputs while paying separation costs

name: Coupled Habitat Biogeochemistry
mechanism: Balance interacting carbon, oxygen, nutrient and microbial inventories over repeated cycles
operating_requirement: Instrumented habitat trials, organisms, reserves and analytical staff
consequence: Find limiting exchanges before increasing habitat occupancy

name: Ecological Life Support Stability
mechanism: Detect drifting biological feedbacks and test bounded corrective interventions
operating_requirement: Continuous observations, independent reserves and reversible intervention capacity
consequence: Maintain an evaluated operating envelope for biological life support

name: Habitat Makeup Supply Planning
mechanism: Schedule external make-up deliveries from measured irrecoverable losses and lead times
operating_requirement: Real suppliers, transport windows, storage and purchasing capacity
consequence: Support partially closed settlements through explicit import dependence

name: Settlement Autonomy Trials
mechanism: Test a settlement against defined durations of external service and supply loss
operating_requirement: Instrumented trial boundary, emergency abort provisions and actual stores
consequence: Certify only the tested duration and operating conditions of autonomy

name: Ocean Settlement Mooring Integration
mechanism: Integrate compliant station keeping and service connections for occupied floating structures
operating_requirement: Site surveys, qualified moorings, inspection craft and service connections
consequence: Support bounded floating occupancy under a qualified sea-state envelope

name: Submerged Habitat Pressure Integrity
mechanism: Qualify occupied enclosures and penetrations against sustained external water pressure
operating_requirement: Pressure-qualified structures, inspections, atmosphere services and rescue access
consequence: Enable defined-duration submerged habitation within certified depth limits

name: Ocean Habitat Escape Systems
mechanism: Provide tested evacuation and refuge paths from a disabled submerged habitat
operating_requirement: Maintained escape systems, trained occupants and reachable rescue capacity
consequence: Reduce entrapment risk with finite rescue time and capacity

name: Planetary Intervention Comparison
mechanism: Compare intervention portfolios against shared environmental baselines, uncertainty and distribution of harms
operating_requirement: Independent observations, evaluators and explicit counterfactual scenarios
consequence: Support informed project choice without treating modeled benefit as achieved restoration

name: Carbon Removal Durability Contracts
mechanism: Tie credited removal to persistence monitoring, reversal liability and make-good obligations
operating_requirement: Verified measurement boundaries, retained monitoring and funded liability
consequence: Prevent temporary storage from silently satisfying durable-removal commitments

name: Restoration Termination Protocols
mechanism: Define monitored stopping and reversal triggers before a large environmental intervention begins
operating_requirement: Baseline evidence, responsible operators and feasible withdrawal measures
consequence: Respond to adverse outcomes without presuming every intervention is reversible

name: Transboundary Environment Experiments
mechanism: Coordinate bounded environmental trials whose effects cross jurisdictions
operating_requirement: Affected-party participation, monitoring, liability and agreed trial limits
consequence: Allow contested research with explicit obligations and independent evidence

name: Rotating Habitat Human Factors
mechanism: Measure motion tolerance, movement and task performance in evaluated rotating environments
operating_requirement: Ground analogs or suitable flight facility, clinicians, consent and measured exposure
consequence: Define evidence-based candidate operating envelopes for rotational habitation

name: Partial Gravity Health Studies
mechanism: Measure longitudinal responses to sustained reduced gravity separately from complete weightlessness
operating_requirement: Suitable experimental environment, carefully justified subjects and long follow-up
consequence: Bound health uncertainty before claiming safe permanent surface settlement

name: Low Gravity Reproductive Research
mechanism: Investigate reproduction and development under altered gravity using staged ethically reviewed models
operating_requirement: Appropriate nonhuman models first, protected facilities, oversight and long observation
consequence: Produce evidence on constraints rather than unlock automatic healthy births

name: Space Radiation Dose Forecasting
mechanism: Combine exposure measurements and shelter geometry with forecast event uncertainty
operating_requirement: Calibrated dosimeters, environment observations and characterized shielding
consequence: Plan bounded exposure and shelter use without eliminating radiation risk

name: Habitat Storm Shelter Operations
mechanism: Move occupants into finite protected volume during hazardous exposure periods
operating_requirement: Qualified shielding, stocked shelter, alarm delivery and practiced occupancy procedures
consequence: Reduce selected radiation exposure while consuming shelter services

name: Habitat Dust Exclusion
mechanism: Separate contaminated exterior equipment and dust from clean habitat interfaces
operating_requirement: Qualified seals, cleaning systems, consumables and particle monitoring
consequence: Limit abrasive and biologically relevant dust entering occupied spaces

name: Habitat Leak Localization
mechanism: Locate and isolate pressure leaks using measured compartment behavior and local sensing
operating_requirement: Pressure sensors, accessible isolation boundaries, repair stocks and responders
consequence: Reduce atmosphere loss through bounded diagnosis and repair

name: Autonomous Habitat Repair
mechanism: Diagnose and execute a qualified subset of repairs with independent post-repair checks
operating_requirement: Accessible modular systems, robot tools, parts, power and human escalation
consequence: Restore selected services during crew absence or delayed advice

name: Habitat Multigenerational Viability
mechanism: Evaluate population health, renewal, life-support and institutional continuity together across generations
operating_requirement: Evidence-bearing long trials, voluntary population participation, supply capacity and independent review
consequence: Determine whether specific long-term habitation conditions are supportable

name: Offworld Child Development Services
mechanism: Adapt supported childhood care, learning and physical development to evaluated habitat constraints
operating_requirement: Established developmental evidence, trained caregivers, protected space and supplies
consequence: Support children already present without treating them as a manufactured resource

name: Crew Conflict Mediation Under Delay
mechanism: Resolve local disputes with review and representation when outside adjudication is delayed
operating_requirement: Locally legitimate procedures, confidential access and records for later review
consequence: Maintain accountable crew governance without instant distant decisions

name: Habitat Demographic Capacity Models
mechanism: Project age-structured care and service demand against real habitat capacity
operating_requirement: Observed population aggregates, service measurements and uncertainty scenarios
consequence: Expose future care and supply shortfalls without assigning reproductive orders

name: Archive Bootstrap Interpreters
mechanism: Package documented decoding steps from simple readable representations to complex archive formats
operating_requirement: Durable media, reference specifications, checked tools and recurring recovery trials
consequence: Recover otherwise unreadable technical records after loss of current software

name: Distributed Skill Custodianship
mechanism: Maintain practiced essential skills at independent locations with funded succession
operating_requirement: Competent mentors, apprentices, facilities and continuing community support
consequence: Reduce simultaneous loss of rare practical capabilities

name: Cross Generation Obligation Review
mechanism: Periodically reconsider inherited commitments with affected cohorts and recorded exit costs
operating_requirement: Legitimate deliberation, accessible evidence and continued essential services
consequence: Permit correction of long projects without erasing obligations or locking descendants into policy

name: Long Baseline Probe Fault Recovery
mechanism: Restore bounded probe functions after faults without timely ground intervention
operating_requirement: Redundant qualified hardware, finite energy, validated recovery software and retained diagnostics
consequence: Extend useful unattended investigation within tested fault coverage

name: Autonomous Probe Science Selection
mechanism: Select observations under power, storage and transmission limits using inspectable scientific priorities
operating_requirement: Qualified instruments, bounded onboard computation and retained decision provenance
consequence: Return prioritized evidence when every observation cannot be transmitted

name: Interstellar Message Recovery
mechanism: Accumulate and decode extremely weak delayed probe signals with explicit uncertainty
operating_requirement: Sufficient receiving aperture, calibrated timing, energy and known coding scheme
consequence: Recover limited information where the physical link budget supports detection

name: Planetary Threat Orbit Covariance
mechanism: Propagate uncertain small-body observations into possible future encounter regions
operating_requirement: Repeated calibrated observations, trajectory computation and independent checking
consequence: Distinguish uncertain possible impacts from better constrained threats

name: Planetary Defense Decision Protocols
mechanism: Assign evidence review, notification and accountable response decisions for a shared impact threat
operating_requirement: Participating authorities, observations, communication and review capacity
consequence: Coordinate response without granting physical deflection capability

name: Impact Deflection Mission Design
mechanism: Design a constrained momentum-transfer mission and assess uncertain target response
operating_requirement: Characterized target, launch hardware, tracking and sufficient warning time
consequence: Investigate a feasible deflection with explicit residual trajectory uncertainty

name: Deflection Outcome Verification
mechanism: Measure post-intervention trajectories and revise residual risk against independent observations
operating_requirement: Surviving observation capacity, calibrated time series and accountable reporting
consequence: Base further action on observed orbital change rather than mission launch alone

name: Long Horizon Project Optioning
mechanism: Stage costly frontier projects with reversible commitments and evidence-dependent expansion
operating_requirement: Real budgets, measured milestones, costed alternatives and termination terms
consequence: Preserve choices when uncertain engineering results change project value

name: Settlement Decommissioning Recovery
mechanism: Plan paid dismantling, contaminant isolation and occupant relocation when a settlement retires
operating_requirement: Reachable transport, receiving capacity, trained crews and funded waste management
consequence: Return qualified materials while accounting for stranded assets and residual hazards

name: Frontier Capability Assurance Cases
mechanism: Assemble traceable evidence that a specific integrated capability meets bounded claims
operating_requirement: Independent review, operating measurements, failure records and explicit assumptions
consequence: Prevent component success from automatically authorizing unsupported settlement-scale claims
